_comment: Transition task: extracts a stable conformation for a GROMACS CG simulation from the upstream TIGER2 task's output (via the flow link), then emits the CG input set. Edited in Task Control. Fields: temperatureC (input in Celsius, auto-converted to Kelvin by the generator), sourceTaskId (optional; defaults to the flow-linked predecessor).
sourceTaskId: FILL-IN: tiger2 task id (or leave empty to use the flow link)
